periods.name: 卡邦克鲁突袭赞达剌饭店
periods.summary: Carbuncle suddenly appears in the hotel, reveals she tracked the team through her domain, knocks out Watson, Eliza and Hilda, traps Lucifelia and abducts Meluette using hypnotized Hilda.
periods.outcome: Team loses Meluette, Hilda and Eliza's field capability; mission priority shifts to hostage rescue.
